claims.evidence: Photo 0 and photo 2 show Canon EOS 800D; photo 0 shows the lens marked 18-55mm.
No photo shows the shutter count screen/EXIF or a shutter-count report.

claims.evidence: Photos do not provide a close, angled view of the lens glass for fungus/scratches.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be much higher than claimed (affects value and expected lifespan).
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo of shutter count from a shutter-count tool (or camera menu/EXIF) showing the exact number.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a used Canon EOS 800D with unknown/high shutter count (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Lens may have fungus, haze, or scratches not visible in these angles (affects image quality).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens front element and rear element under bright light at multiple angles (including edge-to-edge).
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with possible defects (worst-case: treat as not guaranteed clean).

risks.risk: Battery/charger authenticity and condition may be different from 'original' (affects usability).
risks.proof: Clear photos of the battery label (brand/model/serial) and charger label, plus a photo showing both items together.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming battery/charger may be non-original or worn (worst-case: reduce value).

risks.risk: Camera may have been repaired or may have faults (e.g., shutter, autofocus, buttons, sensor issues).
risks.proof: Video/clip showing autofocus lock on a subject + a test shot at different apertures, plus a photo of the camera serial/inside battery compartment.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'not guaranteed fully functional' until tested (worst-case: treat as needing verification).

proof_requests: Send a screenshot/photo of the shutter count number from a shutter-count tool (or EXIF report).
Send close-up, angled photos of the lens front and rear glass under strong light (to check fungus/scratches/haze).
Photo of the battery label/model and charger label (and both items together).
Short test clip: autofocus on a nearby and far subject + a few sample images (including one at wide aperture and one stopped down).
response.reason: The photos clearly identify a Canon EOS 800D with an 18-55mm lens, but the key value drivers (shutter count, lens condition, and whether battery/charger are original and camera is un-repaired) are not provable from the provided images.
